title: memory: destroying an Email leaves Thread emailIds and the Message-ID index stale
description: memory/mod.rs:2036-2061, 2347-2384: destroyed id stays in Thread emailIds, empty Thread not destroyed, Thread state not advanced, message_id_index keeps it (re-import gives alreadyExists with the destroyed id; MDN/parse forEmailId resolves to it). RFC 8621 §3. Restored Emails also append to emailIds unsorted (history.rs:367-371). (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
